abstract: Covers W3C Trace Context and W3C Baggage: the traceparent header (version, trace-id, parent-id, trace-flags, invalid values and higher-version parsing), the tracestate header (keys, values, limits, truncation and mutation), the baggage header (grammar, percent-encoding, properties, limits and mutation), the processing model for tracers, proxies and message buses, and the privacy and security considerations. Version lines: Trace Context Level 1 (W3C Recommendation, 23 November 2021) is current; Trace Context Level 2 (Candidate Recommendation Draft, 28 March 2024) is a preview with posture build, adding the random trace-id flag; W3C Baggage (Candidate Recommendation Snapshot, 30 May 2024) is current in its own family. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out the version lines, traceparent, tracestate, baggage, and the processing model with privacy and security.
